# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::toggle`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

Fluent toggle switch. Built on the same four layers as the button (see `button.rs`): a
[`ToggleLook`](toggle.md#struct.ToggleLook) and its settled values, [`paint`](toggle.md#fn.paint), the Painter-API [`toggle`](toggle.md#fn.toggle) and [`Ui::toggle`](../ui.md#method.Ui.toggle).

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/toggle.rs:1`
